children: Nvidia Corp. (NVDA, Financials) may be gearing up to spend up to $14 billion to expand beyond the semiconductors that fuel artificial intelligence.
According to Bloomberg, which cited people familiar with the subject, the corporation is in advanced talks to purchase AI platform Hugging Face for around $12.9 billion.
A deal might be made as early as this week, though the talks are private and no final agreement has been reached. There's another large number tied to the talks.
The acquisition might involve almost $1 billion to hold onto Hugging Face staff, the article said. That would bring the total to some $14 billion.
Hugging Face has become a key meeting point for AI engineers, providing models, datasets and tools utilized throughout the field.
Owning that ecosystem might push Nvidia's influence further up the AI stack. The business already owns the market for the processors that train and run massive AI models.
An acquisition would put Nvidia in much closer contact with the developers generating such models.
The big question now is if the conversations lead to a deal and how authorities would regard another huge expansion for Nvidia into the wider AI ecosystem.

title: Nvidia Is Nearing a $14 Billion AI Deal With a $1 Billion Twist
